verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is a feature-flag and release-control SaaS, not an agent or AI client, so plugging MCP servers into it to consume their tools is a wrong-axis question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only the opposite role: LaunchDarkly's own MCP server, used by external AI clients such as Cursor and Claude Code. That server-side capability does not make this client-side story applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
